correctness.rationale: For a cubic graph on 2n vertices, count cut edges E: total domination gives E≤2|S|, while distinct nonempty outside fingerprints give E≥2(2n−|S|)−|S|; hence |S|≥ceil(4n/5). The cyclic construction B=(3,1,0,3,0,3,0,0) and Q=(3,0,3,0,0) has |S|=7+4t. All potential equal nonempty fingerprints in a prism with n≥8 must occur for same-rail distance-2 or adjacent-column opposite-rail pairs; these and total domination depend on 5 consecutive columns. An exhaustive truth table validates 10 factors, and block-interface enumeration proves the 10 factors include every window in BQ^t for all t. Standalone checker independently reconstructs original adjacency and 0..6 smaller sets at n=8; no extrapolation substitutes for block-interface proof.

originality.rationale: The closest primary full text, Raza et al. 2021, explicitly conjectures γ_t^L(C_n □ K_2)=ceil(4n/5)+1 for n≡3 mod 5. The new all-n=8+5t construction attains the sharp general lower bound ceil(4n/5), so contradicts that published conjecture, rather than being a paraphrase or a corollary of its Theorem 5. Later inspected generic upper bounds do not imply sharp equality. published-finding corpus and accessible historical-claim comparisons identified no equivalent counterfamily. Priority uncertainty from differently named/unindexed references remains.

value.rationale: The result disproves the complete n≡3 mod 5 infinite branch of a 2021 explicitly formulated locating-total domination conjecture, identifies a new infinite sharp family rather than a numerical isolated case, and gives a reproducible local symbolic construction matching the universal degree-counting lower bound. It restricts future refinements of prism domination classifications; the precise all-parameter counterfamily is mathematically motivated by that published open conjecture.
